This diagnostic tests the plugin search → detail → stream flow using the app’s existing network and WebView/cookie handling. That layer may process some challenge pages, but diagnostics do not force-disable per-host cooldowns. CF/WAF is counted only when an explicit protection signature is detected; providers may still deny access. Diagnostics never automatically disable plugins.
